name: GitLab repo PR list: draft badge, unknown diff stats and sync status
description: Spec 2026-10-16-gitlab-merge-requests (AC-50, AC-24). Switches the active repo to the seeded GitLab fixture space-profit/platform/crm-frontend (seeded only with SEED_GITLAB_FIXTURE=1 — the hermetic runner sets it) via the sidebar repo switcher, then asserts the PR list renders the fixture rows from persisted data: PR #5 with its Draft badge (located by data-testid=pr-draft-badge, since the word can appear in PR titles), PR #6 with an em dash for its unknown diff stats (aria-label 'Diff stats not available yet'), and the sync status line. The server runs with DEVDIGEST_HOSTS_OFFLINE=true, so no request ever reaches gitlab.com. Assumes the hermetic runner (scripts/e2e.sh).

open the sidebar repo switcher (active repo = seeded GitHub demo)
